source: archaeologicalrescue.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Khufu_X33_W1300_P2_Heights_3D2.html and Osiris_Shaft_Interactive_3D.html (read in Hassan's browser 13 Nov 2026; files cannot be downloaded to the sandbox)
osiris_model: geometry of the known shaft only (levels, passages, vertices); contains no radar/tomogram values and no images. Nothing to analyse.
khufu_own_caveat: Face-normal depth is a visualization hypothesis. It does not validate the physical depth direction or identify chambers.
khufu_grid: two curtains (Center y=+0.1 m; Minus11 y=-10.9 m), 73 positions up the east face (1 m westward each) x 1999 depth rows (0.05 m, 0.1-100 m) along the inward face normal (-0.7839, 0, -0.6208)
method: values recovered from the embedded 73x1999 PNG textures by nearest matplotlib-magma colour (256 levels, 0-0.05); max squared colour error 16; resolution 0.0002

chamber_boxes_ASSUMED_m.note: approximate, from memory of published surveys, NOT checked against Petrie; x east of centre, z above pavement

chamber_test.null: same-size boxes on a 4 m grid inside the pyramid outline covered by the curtain (442-453 boxes)
